source_policy: Primary publications, official code/docs and official write-ups. Access depth explicit. No downloaded third-party full text redistributed.

entries.title: ECG digitization, Stenhede et al.
entries.engineering_reading: Main Hough/projective method is distinct from the explicitly experimental TPS branch.
entries.access: Full official Europe PMC XML read by research agent, primary code read. Nature direct access redirected.

entries.title: Methods for generating an image of a graphical representation
entries.engineering_reading: Point graph/cells, missing-vertex regression and original per-cell sampling are prior art.
entries.access: Description and claims read, no proprietary executable established.

entries.title: High precision ECG digitization using artificial intelligence
entries.engineering_reading: Leader segments waveforms. Dotter/Gridder/Undistortion normalize geometry. Historical Lauder reference points to Leader.
entries.access: Published primary indexed text and preprint methods read. Direct original pages blocked in this environment.

entries.title: Systems and methods for extracting waveforms from a digital image
entries.engineering_reading: Column candidates, baselines and continuity concern extraction. Patent does not use the word Leader.
entries.access: Primary description and claims read. Nominal linkage to Leader not established by patent.

entries.title: 17th place solution
entries.engineering_reading: Template pose, MONAI native windows, weighted points and trace-mask auxiliary filtering.
entries.access: Full official public write-up read, no new model execution.

entries.title: 1st place solution
entries.engineering_reading: Subpixel weighted means, surface outlier rejection, missing-grid completion and direct original-image remapping.
entries.access: Full official public write-up read, no new model execution.
entries.authors: outrunner, Yijun, Arya, Bob, Shane Hsieh

entries.title: 2nd place solution
entries.engineering_reading: Unmodified Heng stage0/1. Linear-domain SNR aggregation influenced focus on easy and medium cases.
entries.access: Full official public write-up read, no new model execution.

entries.title: 3rd place solution
entries.engineering_reading: High-resolution sampling and indexed-grid refinement. Fixed template/layout assumptions.
entries.access: Full official public write-up read, no new model execution.

entries.title: 4th place solution
entries.engineering_reading: Native 704-square overlap windows, joint grid/layout and global line indices with fixed classes.
entries.access: Full official public write-up read, no new model execution.

entries.title: 5th place solution
entries.engineering_reading: Dense pseudo-correspondences, iterative matching and local robust K-neighbor homographies.
entries.access: Full official public write-up read, no new model execution.

entries.title: 9th place solution
entries.engineering_reading: ALIKED/LightGlue and RANSAC template pose before grid refinement.
entries.access: Full official public write-up read, no new model execution.

entries.title: UVDoc
entries.engineering_reading: Coarse 2D/3D mesh predicts sampling coordinates. Does not establish metric ECG aspect.
entries.access: Primary method and official training/demo code read. Checkpoint exists in tree, not downloaded.

entries.title: SyntheticDoc
entries.engineering_reading: Physical deformation data and lightweight baseline favor testing data quality. ECG transfer unmeasured.
entries.access: Full primary paper and official code/docs read. Weights not executed.

entries.title: D2Dewarp
entries.engineering_reading: Dual H/V line evidence and backward map are established.
entries.access: Primary methods and official model/train/predict code read.

entries.title: AADD
entries.engineering_reading: UV axial alignment and ROI-based second pass are prior art.
entries.access: Primary method and official README read. Full inference release still coming soon at pin.

entries.title: DvD
entries.engineering_reading: Diffusion of coordinates followed by original RGB sampling. Generalization and cost need measurement.
entries.access: Full primary paper, official docs and validation code read.

entries.title: DocRes
entries.engineering_reading: Use geometric coordinate branch separately from appearance restoration.
entries.access: Primary method and official inference branch read.

entries.title: DocGeoNet
entries.engineering_reading: Global 3D geometry and local line evidence, without assuming ECG waves are text lines.
entries.access: Primary abstract and official README inspected, full code not audited.

entries.title: DewarpNet
entries.engineering_reading: 3D shape plus 2D mapping is established.
entries.access: Primary abstract/method and official README inspected.

entries.title: DocTr
entries.engineering_reading: Geometry and illumination branches should be compared separately.
entries.access: Primary abstract and official README inspected, commit not pinned.

entries.title: DocUNet
entries.engineering_reading: Historical dense dewarping baseline, not evidence of physical scale.
entries.access: Primary abstract inspected.

entries.title: Deformed Lattice Detection, Park et al. 2009
entries.engineering_reading: Lattice proposals, degree-four graph and alternating registration are prior art.
entries.access: Author-hosted primary abstract/method read.

entries.title: Scalable Locally Injective Mappings
entries.engineering_reading: Sparse distortion optimization needs feasible initialization and does not certify physical truth.
entries.access: Author primary project and official repository read.

entries.title: MAGSAC++
entries.engineering_reading: Robust estimator to ablate, not a cure for unobserved pitch or IDs.
entries.access: Primary paper and official OpenCV USAC documentation read.

entries.title: Digital diffeomorphism, Liu et al.
entries.engineering_reading: Positive central-difference Jacobian alone can miss digital folds. Audit actual interpolation.
entries.access: Primary paper read by document agent. Root PMC browser access blocked.

entries.title: Conformal Risk Control
entries.engineering_reading: Monotone expected bounded loss under exchangeability is not automatically selective ratio risk.
entries.access: Full primary assumptions and limitations read.

entries.title: ECG-Image-Database 2026
entries.engineering_reading: Public capture and waveform evidence. Pairing is not dense geometric truth.
entries.access: Official full XML and official dataset metadata/listing read.

entries.title: PM-ECG-ID
entries.engineering_reading: 100 source ECGs, 6000 photos, printed segments available. No dense warp ground truth stated.
entries.access: Official metadata read, archive not downloaded.

entries.title: PhysioNet 2024 evaluation
entries.engineering_reading: Temporal/baseline shift allowances require separate no-shift metrics.
entries.access: Actual scoring source read.
